name: aionui-source-level-recovery
title: Recover AionUi integration to a source-level release workflow
description: Turn the recovered 1.1.2 bundled AionUi state into a repeatable source build, staging, and NSIS packaging workflow without treating staging as permanent source.
creator: JASMINE145-ACT

subtasks.title: Restore bundled 1.1.2 Mixing UI + org SSO login + WanD Guid cards on D:/CCB-Wanding
Inventory 1.1.2 staging AionUi contents and map each runtime file back to a source or patch input
Compare bundled 1.1.2 AionUi behavior with aionui-src dev behavior and identify missing CCB Guid integration source changes
Make source edits flow through aionui-src build output into ccb-installer staging instead of editing staging by hand
Full cold build from git; verify install behaves like 1.1.2 oracle (ship as 1.1.3-dev)
Audit and clean stale generated AionUi/installer artifacts after the source pipeline is established

notes: 2026-06-26: Phase 0 runtime recovery done. All repos pushed (Mixing real submodules @ 5513401). Phase 3 staging manifest passed (build-wanding 1.1.3-dev with SkipBuild/SkipAionUiBuild/SkipPipMcp). 06-25 python/system refactor recovered @ f8ab39ae. meta.hard_rule: Do not treat ccb-installer/staging/AionUi as source. It is a release baseline and comparison oracle until the source pipeline reproduces it.
